name: dsh-floating-window
description: Pops a DSH conversation into a free-floating, always-on-top desktop window usable over any other application: pick any Session the DSH window lists, follow its transcript live, keep writing into it, and hand it back to the main window. Keeps the window's own 悬浮窗 settings page (appearance light / dark / follow-DSH / follow-Windows, always-on-top, remembered geometry, default size, opacity, session title in the title bar, Esc to close) and a cache-and-log cleanup card. One package, three halves: host.js serves the page, the settings, the theme channel, the Session routes and the cache routes, and owns the window process; client.js adds the 浮窗 composer button, the 悬浮窗 settings page and the open-in-main-window hand-off; window/ is the WinForms + WebView2 program that draws the frameless window.
